Mrs. Fisher: By now you have caught more than a dozen Bucketmouths.
You: Bucketmouths? 
Mrs. Fisher: That’s what we call Largemouth Basses in the South. 
You: Right, good to know. 
You: Sorry, but I gotta ask. What do you call smallmouth basses?
Mrs. Fisher: It has a lot of names. In my home town old fishers would call it rock bass, but when I learned more about fishes I found out that rock bass is a completely different species. Since then I just call it Smallmouth. {{wi}}Or Smallie when I visit friends in Alabama. 
You: Right.
